title.en: B1 review: tenses, conditionals, passive, reported speech and linkers

explain.ko: B1을 마무리하는 이 단원에서는 지금까지 배운 구조를 합쳐 긴 글을 씁니다. 경험·변화는 현재완료(So far I've travelled ...), 이야기는 과거형과 과거진행형, 후회는 제3조건문(If I had left earlier, ...), 사실은 수동태(This bridge was built in 1990), 남의 말은 간접화법(He said that ...)으로 말합니다. 연결어(although, however, in order to, so that, to sum up)를 사용해 글의 흐름을 만들고 문단을 시작과 끝으로 정리하세요. 편지는 인사 → 근황 → 내용 → 끝인사 순으로 씁니다.
explain.en: This last B1 unit combines the structures you've learnt to write a longer text. Use the present perfect for experience and change (So far I've travelled ...), the past simple and continuous for stories, the third conditional for regrets (If I had left earlier, ...), the passive for facts (This bridge was built in 1990) and reported speech for what others said (He said that ...). Use linkers (although, however, in order to, so that, to sum up) to give the text a flow and organise paragraphs into an opening and a closing. A letter follows the order: greeting → news → main content → closing.

notes.en: In longer texts change tenses to fit your purpose.

notes.ko: 전달화법에서는 시제를 한 단계 과거로 옮깁니다(is → was, will → would).
notes.en: In reported speech shift tenses back one step (is → was, will → would).

notes.ko: 문단마다 한 가지 생각을 담으면 읽기 쉽습니다.
notes.en: Put one idea in each paragraph.

prompt.ko: B1에서 배운 시제, 조건문, 수동태, 전달화법을 사용해 친구에게 보내는 6문장 안부 편지를 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write a 6-sentence letter to a friend using the tenses, conditionals, passive and reported speech you learnt at B1.

task.model: Hi, how are you? Last weekend I went hiking with my friends and it was great fun. So far I've travelled to three countries. If I had left earlier, I would have seen the sunrise from the top. My teacher said that a new project was starting next month. I look forward to hearing from you soon.

model_trans.ko: 안녕, 잘 지내? 지난 주말에는 친구들과 등산을 갔고 정말 즐거웠어. 지금까지 나는 세 나라를 여행했어. 더 일찍 출발했더라면 정상에서 일출을 볼 수 있었을 거야. 선생님은 다음 달에 새 프로젝트가 시작된다고 말씀하셨어. 곧 소식을 기다릴게.
model_trans.en: Hi, how are you? Last weekend I went hiking with my friends and it was great fun. So far I've travelled to three countries. If I had left earlier, I would have seen the sunrise from the top. My teacher said that a new project was starting next month. I look forward to hearing from you soon.
